title: 月球漫游车解析式世界模型 v0：可实现性验证
model_class_note: NOT a learned world model: no neural network, no training, no image generation. It is an explicit transition function s_{t+1}=f(s_t,a_t).
question: 在零训练、零依赖、单机条件下，能否用真实 LOLA 高程给出物理自洽、可机器校验、可复现的月球漫游车状态预测？
design: analytic transition function; three closed-form climb limits (traction/torque/power); real LOLA GDR DEM; scripted-DEM test doubles to decouple gating logic from DEM resolution

pre_registration.criteria: K1 component strict monotonicity; K2 theta_limit==min(components), tol 1e-12 rad; K3 required_power(theta_P(v))==P_max, rel<1e-9; K4 flat-ground traction energy matches Crr*m*g*d/eta, rel<1e-9; K5 blocked gating displacement strictly 0; K6 battery termination with non-negative battery; K7 SHA256 determinism + 200 random scenarios free of NaN/Inf
pre_registration.kill_rule: any K1-K7 FAIL -> verdict FAILED, no parameter tuning, no criterion modification

test_instance_correction.what: first instantiation placed the test at t_s=synodic_month/2 where solar elevation is 90 deg at (0,0), so solar input (1.0 Wh) far exceeded per-step consumption (0.004 Wh) and the battery could never deplete - the instance was impossible to pass by construction
test_instance_correction.fix: moved to a no-sunlight instant (solar elevation -90 deg); criterion untouched; detail recorded in checks.K6.correction_note

results.binding_constraint_note: theta_traction = arctan(mu - Crr) is mass-independent; default params give 26.5651 deg, consistent with published lunar-rover traction-limited climb limits. Independently derived here, not fitted.

known_limitations: 16 ppd DEM => ~1.9 km/pixel and ~3.8 km slope baseline: REGIONAL trend, NOT wheel-level traversability. Any wheel-level conclusion at this resolution is INVALID.
slip model is a parametric assumption, not terramechanics; uncalibrated
illumination is a simplified ephemeris (<10 deg amplitude accuracy); not NASA SPICE; no terrain self-occlusion
not a learned world model; no neural network, no training
E1: single analytic model, single data source, NO third-party validation, NO external calibration. K1-K7 passing means internal consistency only, NOT correctness.
compute_cost: 0 yuan. No paid services, no GPUs, no training.
no_external_contact: No contact or cooperation with any external institution, including the Deep Space Exploration Laboratory. No claim of such contact may be made from this artifact.
